description: ENERGYDATA.INFO - User Manual is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Information technology", published or maintained by Christopher Arderne (World Bank Group). User manual for the ENERGYDATA.INFO platform. Latest revision: July 2018 Contact: energydata@worldbankgroup.org. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in PDF. The portal files it under Information technology. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
